description.value:
(Prerequisite: Eberron Campaign, Can't Have Another Dragonmark Feat)

The Mark of Hospitality of House Ghallanda manifests on your skin. You gain the following benefits.

Ever Hospitable. When you make a Charisma (Persuasion) check or an ability check using Brewer's Supplies or Cook's Utensils, you can roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the check.

Innkeeper's Magic. @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplPurifyFood]{Purify Food and Drink} and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplUnseenServ]{Unseen Servant} are always prepared for you. You can cast each of them once without a spell slot, and you regain that use when you finish a Long Rest; you can also cast them with any spell slots of the appropriate level you have. Your spellcasting ability for these spells is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (chosen when you take this feat). From character level 3, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCalmEmotio]{Calm Emotions} is also always prepared for you, and you can cast it the same way.

Spells of the Mark. If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature, the spells on the Mark of Hospitality Spells table are added to that feature's spell list.

Foundry Note

The effect Ever Hospitable adds the 1d4 to the Persuasion checks; add it yourself to the checks using Brewer's Supplies or Cook's Utensils. The spells of character level 3 are granted when you reach that level: choose the same spellcasting ability as for the others. The Spells of the Mark are not added to your class spell list automatically: prepare them from the compendium if your class can.
